purpose.summary: ARIC461 is a CICS online program that displays and manages the main menu of an application called GESTARTS. It handles user input (function keys, ENTER, CLEAR), validates menu choices (1–6), routes to sub-programs (ARIC462–ARIC467), and manages invalid key/choice error messages.
